physical.title: wrapper
physical.summary: Woman's wrapper; composed of sixteen narrow strips, hand sewn together. Indigo-dyed cotton warp and (hidden) red-dyed cotton weft. Pattern blocks in each strip: supplementary weft float motifs  including hands, animals, fish, and combs combined with supplementary weft bands in stripes of white, red-, indigo- and brown-dyed cotton. Single lines of soumak braiding in white cotton at both ends. Loose warp thread fringes at both ends.

cultural.vision_reason: A man's hand-woven strip cloth sewn into a sleeveless tunic, with characteristic warp-striped and weft-float patterning typical of Ewe/Ewe-Asante kente-style strip weaving; this construction and patterning is consistent with Ewe cloth traditions.

physical.title: gown; cloth
physical.summary: Man’s cloth, formed of twenty strips of imported European yarn, hand-woven and hand-sewn together along the selvedges. The cloth has been folded in halves and the stitching removed along the centre to create a hole for the head, in order to form a crude sleeveless tunic by sewing the sides together while leaving holes for the arms. The warp is of a single pattern throughout, with solid stripes of blue, white and red yarn on one side, and two stripes on the other, where an alternating red and blue weft pattern has been introduced by varying the placing of the weft, which is of blue cotton throughout. A second pair of heddles has been used to create solid bands of weft decoration which have been woven in at irregular intervals along each strip; these are composed of lines of red, blue, yellow and white cotton. The ends have machine-sewn hems. The garment has been patched in places.in red cloth.

physical.title: garment
physical.summary: Woman's wrapper (Anlo Ewe) made of imported industrial cotton, composed of twelve narrow strips machine-stitched together. The warp has a standard pattern of thin stripes of alternating blue and red cotton flanking a central broad orange stripe. The ground weft is of blue cotton, with variegated weft-faced blocks formed of twisted orange and yellow and white and yellow threads, with further double bands of plain weave in turquoise. Machine-hemmed at both warp ends.

physical.title: wrapper
physical.summary: Man's wrapper; composed of eighteen narrow strips, hand sewn together. Alternating warp- and weft-faced strips. Warp strips in indigo-dyed cotton with central white cotton stripe and  weft-faced bands in red-dyed cotton edged with white cotton. Weft-faced strips in red-dyed cotton with narrow stripes in indigo- and yellow-dyed cotton and weft-faced bands in white, yellow- and indigo-dyed cotton. Weft-faced block-coloured bands align across the cloth. Hand sewn hems at both ends.

physical.summary: Man's wrapper (Ewe kente); composed of twenty-four narrow strips, hand sewn together. Repeating warp stripes in green, red, white and indigo. Aligned weft-faced blocks in stripes of purple and yellow cotton at both ends of wrapper. Loose warp thread fringes at both ends.
